items.headline: Texas DE Colin Simmons, FBS sack leader, returns vs. Missouri
items.description: Texas edge rusher Colin Simmons, who leads FBS with 10.5 sacks and 16 tackles for loss this season, has returned after a 2-game absence for the No. 7 Longhorns.

items.headline: Illinois coach Bret Bielema takes veiled shot at SEC, CFP
items.description: Big Ten coaches continue to be rankled by the initial College Football Playoff rankings, with Illinois coach Bret Bielema taking the latest veiled shot at the SEC.

items.headline: Analyzing how Mizzou's run offense has been successful
items.description: SEC Now's Benjamin Watson breaks down how the No. 19 Tigers has had success offensively while Chris Doering dives into how the No. 10 Longhorns can stop their momentum.

items.headline: Matt Barrie on massive Week 10: 'This is the tipping point weekend'
items.description: Barrie says the the conclusion of Saturday's slate will flip the entire football landscape on its axis due to the amount of ranked, decisive games as the CFP approaches.

items.headline: Chris Doering expects five SEC teams to compete in 2026 CFP
items.description: SEC This Morning's Doering and Peter Burns use historical data and the Allstate Playoff Predictor to discuss the SEC presence in this year's College Football Playoffs.

items.headline: Sources: SEC considering luxury tax for excessive spending on players
items.description: The SEC is mulling a luxury tax on programs that spend more on players than the allotted revenue-sharing cap under the House v. NCAA settlement.
